strings.compat.cache.expired: The refreshed data has expired: its restrictions still apply, but nothing it checks or verifies is trusted until it is refreshed again.
strings.compat.cache.from_newer_product: The refreshed data needs a newer version of Codex Auto Resume, so the data bundled with this version applies.
strings.compat.cache.from_the_future: The refreshed data is dated after this computer's clock: its restrictions apply, but nothing it checks or verifies is trusted until the clock is right.
strings.compat.cache.rejected: The refreshed data on this computer could not be used, so the data bundled with this version applies.
strings.compat.cache.superseded: The refreshed data is older than the data bundled with this version, which applies instead.
strings.compat.capability.loaded_state_detection: Telling whether a conversation is open
strings.compat.capability.not_loaded_recovery: Recovering a conversation that is not open
strings.compat.capability.projection_freshness: Knowing Codex's own record is up to date
strings.compat.capability.recovery_turn_tracking: Following the turn a recovery starts
strings.compat.capability.transient_classificati: Telling a passing error from a lasting one
strings.compat.reported.meaning: Reported by others: how many of the reports other people filed for this exact Codex version saw a recovery work, saw one fail, or saw neither; a report that saw both is counted in each. They are not checks made on this computer, and they change nothing here.
strings.compat.meaning.COMPATIBLE: Compatible: the checks on this computer pass, but the maintainer has neither checked nor verified this exact Codex version.
strings.compat.meaning.FAILED_HERE: Failed here: this exact Codex version is checked or verified, but a check on this computer failed, so the cause is most likely this computer rather than the Codex version.
strings.compat.meaning.INCOMPATIBLE: Incompatible: a check on this computer failed on a Codex version nobody has checked, or the compatibility data says it does not work with this Codex version.
strings.compat.meaning.UNKNOWN: Unknown: it could not be established, because a check could not run on this computer.
strings.compat.meaning.VERIFIED: Verified: a real recovery on this exact Codex version has confirmed it.
strings.compat.meaning.CHECKED: Checked: the maintainer's checks pass on this exact Codex version, but no real recovery on it has confirmed this yet.
strings.compat.refused.future: it is dated after this computer's clock
strings.compat.refused.invalid: it is not valid compatibility data
strings.compat.refused.newer: it needs a newer version of Codex Auto Resume
strings.compat.refused.not_saved: it could not be saved on this computer
strings.compat.refused.rollback: it is older than the data already in force
strings.compat.status.absent: No check yet: the watcher checks when it runs.
strings.compat.status.engine_changed: Codex has changed since the last check. Stop the watcher and start it again to check the new version.
strings.compat.status.invalid: The last check could not be read, so nothing in it is relied on.
strings.compat.status.stale: The last check is too old to rely on. The watcher checks again while it runs.
strings.compat.title: Codex compatibility
strings.confirm.cancel: Stop recovering "{name}"? A continuation already running in Codex is not stopped.
strings.confirm.cancel_all: Stop every pending recovery? Anything already handed to Codex is withdrawn only if it is still queued.
strings.confirm.clear: Hide finished recoveries from the history? Nothing is deleted, and recoveries that may still change stay visible.
strings.confirm.repair: Run setup again to repair the Windows registrations, and start the watcher if it is stopped? Settings, pending recoveries, a pause and the sign-in choice are all kept.
strings.confirm.reset: Give "{name}" its attempts back? It waits and is checked again; nothing is sent now.
strings.confirm.stop_watcher: Stop the watcher? It finishes the check it is in and then stops. Nothing waiting is lost, and nothing is recovered until it runs again.
strings.confirm.thread_off: Turn automatic recovery off for "{name}"? Its waiting recoveries are cancelled.
strings.confirm.thread_on: Turn automatic recovery back on for "{name}"? Nothing is sent now; every check still applies.
strings.confirm.update: Version {latest} has been published. Download and install it? The archive is checked against its published checksum before anything runs, and your settings, your pause, everything waiting and the sign-in choice are all kept.
strings.confirm.prerelease: Version {version} is a pre-release: published before its release is finished, and tested less than a release. Install it? It is checked against its published checksum before anything runs, it stays in the edition you have, and your settings, your pause, everything waiting and the sign-in choice are all kept.
strings.continuation.detailed.network_transient: The previous attempt was interrupted by a temporary network problem. Check the existing conversation context and the current state of the work, then continue the same task from where it stopped without repeating work that is already complete.
strings.continuation.detailed.rate_limit_transie: The previous attempt was interrupted by a temporary rate limit. Check the existing conversation context and the current state of the work, then continue the same task from where it stopped without repeating work that is already complete.
strings.continuation.detailed.server_5xx: The previous attempt was interrupted by a temporary server error. Check the existing conversation context and the current state of the work, then continue the same task from where it stopped without repeating work that is already complete.
strings.continuation.detailed.stream_interrupted: The previous response was interrupted before it finished. Check the existing conversation context and the current state of the work, then continue the same task from where it stopped without repeating work that is already complete.
strings.continuation.detailed.timeout: The previous attempt was interrupted by a timeout. Check the existing conversation context and the current state of the work, then continue the same task from where it stopped without repeating work that is already complete.
strings.continuation.detailed.usage_limit: The previous attempt was interrupted by a usage limit. Check the existing conversation context and the current state of the work, then continue the same task from where it stopped without repeating work that is already complete.
strings.continuation.standard.network_transient: The task was interrupted by a temporary network problem. Please retry.
strings.continuation.standard.rate_limit_transie: The task was interrupted by a temporary rate limit. Please retry.
strings.continuation.standard.server_5xx: The task was interrupted by a temporary server error. Please retry.
strings.continuation.standard.stream_interrupted: The response was interrupted before completion. Please continue the previous task.
strings.continuation.standard.timeout: The task was interrupted by a timeout. Please retry.
strings.continuation.standard.usage_limit: The task was interrupted because the usage limit was reached. Please retry.
strings.custom.dashboard_only: Custom messages are written in the Dashboard, so text sent into your conversations is never set from inside one.
strings.custom.fallback: An empty message falls back to the message for every interruption, and then to the Standard message.
strings.custom.per_reason_title: Message for one kind of interruption
strings.custom.placeholder: Type the message to send to Codex
strings.custom.refusal.forbidden_placeholder: {placeholder} would put private information into the message.
strings.custom.refusal.unknown_placeholder: {placeholder} is not a placeholder this product knows.
strings.custom.verbatim: Sent exactly as written. It is never translated or reworded, and changing either language leaves it as it is.
strings.diag.compat_acting_differs: The watcher is still acting on what it found when it started. Stop it and start it again from this page to check again.
strings.diag.compat_busy: An installation or a repair is running. Refresh once it has finished.
strings.diag.compat_failed: The refresh did not finish, so nothing was changed.
strings.diag.compat_incomplete: Files this installation is made of are missing, so the data could not be refreshed. Install it again from the release archive.
strings.diag.compat_refreshed: Compatibility data #{sequence} is now in force.
strings.diag.compat_refreshing: Asking GitHub for the compatibility data...
strings.diag.compat_refused: The downloaded data was refused ({code}): {reason}. The data in force before still applies.
strings.diag.compat_unavailable: The compatibility data could not be fetched, so nothing was changed.
strings.diag.export_done: Diagnostics saved. Ids are aliases and paths are removed; read the file before sharing it.
strings.diag.export_exists: That file already exists; choose a new name.
strings.diag.repair_busy: An installation or a repair is already running. Try again once it has finished.
strings.diag.repair_incomplete: Files this installation is made of are missing, so setup could not run. Install it again from the release archive.
strings.diag.repair_no_entry: Settings > Apps still has no entry for this installation: the copy of the installer its Uninstall button runs is missing, and Repair has no copy to put back. Run this version's Setup program and choose Repair, or install the next update: either one puts the copy and the entry back.
strings.diag.repair_running: Setup is taking longer than usual and is still working. It carries on in the background; look at this page again in a minute.
strings.diag.inside_app: This Dashboard may have been opened from inside {app}. If so, Windows would keep what this sets up inside that app: the entry in Settings > Apps, the start at sign-in, the notifications' name, the link handler and the Start menu entry. Open the Dashboard from the Start menu and do this there.
strings.diag.stop_finishing: The watcher is finishing the check it is in, and stops when that is done.
strings.diag.stop_unknown: Whether the watcher stopped could not be confirmed.
strings.diag.update_could_not_ask: GitHub could not be asked just now. This says nothing about whether an update exists.
strings.diag.github_rate_limited: GitHub refused because this network has used up its limit of requests to GitHub for now (a VPN or a shared connection often does). The limit resets at {time}; try again after that.
strings.diag.github_rate_limited_unknown: GitHub refused because this network has used up its limit of requests to GitHub for now (a VPN or a shared connection often does). The limit resets within an hour; try again after that.
strings.diag.update_failed: The update check did not finish.
strings.diag.update_incomplete: Files this installation is made of are missing, so it could not be checked. Install it again from the release archive.
strings.diag.update_is_current: Version {version} is the newest published release.
strings.diag.update_is_current_unchecked: Version {version} is the newest published release, but pre-releases could not be checked, so a newer pre-release may have been published.
strings.diag.update_is_newer_local: This build is ahead of the newest published release, so there is nothing to install.
strings.diag.update_is_newer_local_unchecked: This build is newer than the latest release, v{version}, but pre-releases could not be checked, so a newer pre-release may have been published.
strings.diag.update_reopen: Close this window and open it again so it runs the new version.
strings.diag.update_running: It is taking longer than usual and is still working. It carries on in the background; look at this page again in a few minutes.
strings.diag.update_watcher_restarted: The watcher was restarted and is running the new version.
strings.diag.update_watcher_same: The watcher that is running is still the one from before the update, so it is running the old code. Stop it and start it again from this page.
strings.diag.update_watcher_unknown: Whether the watcher restarted could not be confirmed.
strings.diag.upgrade_pending: An older watcher still owns the state; finish by restarting the watcher

strings.error.not_exhausted: that recovery has not been exhausted
strings.error.not_installed: the watcher is not installed here
strings.error.observing: that recovery is already running in Codex
strings.error.possibly_sent: that recovery may already have been sent
strings.error.request_failed: the request could not be completed

strings.error.state_busy: the state is busy; the cancel was not recorded
strings.error.thread_mismatch: that recovery belongs to a different conversation
strings.error.upgrade_pending: Upgrade pending: an older watcher still owns the state. Use Stop watcher, then Start watcher, or sign out and back in.
strings.event.disabled_threads_with_pending: Conversations switched off with pending work
strings.event.dispatched_despite_delete: Ran although it was taken back
strings.explain.none_selected: Select a task to see why it is waiting.
strings.explain.title: Why it is waiting
strings.field.max_no_progress: Stop after this many turns without progress
strings.field.notification_card: Show notifications as a card beside the notification area
strings.field.show_tray: Show the icon in the notification area
strings.help.continuation_language: The language of the message sent to Codex. Unless it follows the interface, changing the interface language leaves it as it is.
strings.help.interface_language: Used by the Dashboard, the notification-area popup, notifications and the panel in Codex.
strings.help.limits: Sets how hard recovery tries before it stops and leaves the task to you.
strings.help.notices_stay: A notification of a kind chosen here stays on screen until you click it, instead of going away by itself after a while: the card beside the notification area, or Windows' own notification, which then has a button to close it.
strings.help.notification_card: Notifications appear as a card beside the notification area and are also kept in Windows' notification center. When this is off - or while Do not disturb is on, an app is full screen, a screen reader is running, or the session is locked or remote - Windows shows its own notification instead.
strings.help.recovery: Only kinds of failure the product can recognize are ever recovered. Turning one off stops it; turning one on cannot make an unknown failure recoverable.
strings.help.reduce_motion: Stops every animation - the status light's breathing, controls that glide, a notification card sliding in - in the Dashboard, the notification-area popup and icon, the notification card, the taskbar button and the panel in Codex, in every design. Windows' own Animation effects setting is always honored as well.
strings.help.start_with_codex: Codex starts this plugin whenever it opens, and the watcher starts with it if it is not already running. This is separate from starting at sign-in: either or both can be on. It changes nothing about what is recovered.
strings.help.style.custom: Your own words, sent exactly as you type them.
strings.help.style.detailed: Also asks Codex to check the work so far and continue without repeating what is done.
strings.help.style.minimal: Only asks Codex to retry, without saying why.
strings.help.style.standard: Says why the task stopped, then asks Codex to retry. Recommended.
strings.help.theme: Light or dark for the Dashboard, the notification-area popup and the notification card, and for the panel in Codex while Theme in Codex is Same as Theme. Use system setting follows Windows for the first three and Codex's own theme for the panel.
strings.help.panel_theme: Light or dark for the panel in Codex alone. Same as Theme uses the choice above; Codex's theme follows Codex whatever the Theme is.
strings.help.design: Soft is raised; Classic (v0.6.2) is flat, with accent bars; Plain is flat and grey.
strings.history.reset_limit: Its attempts were already given back as many times as allowed; continue this task in Codex yourself.
strings.history.reset_thread_off: Automatic recovery is off for this conversation; switch it on before recovery can run.
strings.msg.cancelled: Automatic resume disabled for this task.
strings.msg.conflict: Another auto-resume installation is already registered to start at sign-in. Running two watchers could resume the same task twice, so setup stopped. Remove the other installation first, then run setup again.
strings.msg.conflict_other: Another auto-resume installation is also registered to start at sign-in. Two watchers could resume the same task twice; keep only one.
strings.msg.disabled: Auto resume is off. Nothing will be resumed until it is turned on again.
strings.msg.no_pending: No tasks are waiting to be resumed.
strings.msg.not_installed: The Windows runtime is not installed yet, so there is nothing for the watcher to run. The plugin carries a setup script that downloads the matching release, checks it and installs it:
strings.msg.not_installed_hint: Nothing else is needed first: no Python, no administrator rights and no manual download.
strings.msg.python_missing: Python 3.12 or newer is required to run the auto-resume watcher.
strings.msg.ready_b2: Resume only the exact interrupted task
strings.msg.ready_b4: Do not resume when state is uncertain
strings.msg.ready_title: Codex Auto Resume is ready to be configured.
strings.msg.setup_autostart: It will also start automatically when you sign in to Windows.
strings.msg.setup_done: Auto resume is set up and the watcher is running.
strings.msg.setup_incomplete: Setup did not finish: preparing the recovery state or switching recovery on failed. Run `doctor` to see why.
strings.msg.setup_unconfirmed: Auto resume is set up, but the watcher could not be confirmed running. Open the Dashboard, or run `doctor`, to check.
strings.msg.setup_unconfirmed_yet: Auto resume is set up. The watcher is not confirmed running yet; it is looked at again at the end.
strings.msg.toast_cancelled_body: This task will not be recovered automatically.
strings.msg.toast_exhausted_body: Out of recovery attempts for this task.
strings.msg.toast_failed_body: The attempt did not go through. Nothing more will be sent automatically for this task.
strings.msg.toast_no_progress_body: Recovery produced no progress, so it was stopped.
strings.msg.toast_resumed_body: The interrupted task is running again.
strings.msg.toast_starting_body: Sending the continuation to this conversation.
strings.msg.toast_stopped_body: Automatic recovery stopped for this task.
strings.msg.toast_handed_over_body: You are continuing this conversation yourself, so it will not be resumed automatically.
strings.msg.toast_parent_cancelled_body: Automatic recovery was cancelled for this task, so it will not be resumed automatically.
strings.msg.toast_transient: Codex was temporarily interrupted. Retrying automatically.
strings.msg.toast_unknown_body: Nothing will be sent again; check the conversation.
strings.msg.toast_usage_at: Codex usage limit reached. This task will resume at {time}.
strings.msg.toast_usage_soon: Codex usage limit reached. This task will resume after the reset.
strings.msg.uninstalled: Auto resume has been removed. Your Codex conversations were not touched.
strings.msg.waiting_loaded: Waiting for this conversation to be loaded
strings.msg.waiting_reset: Task will resume after the usage reset
strings.note.reopen_pending: The window will reopen in the new language or theme once you save or discard your changes.
strings.overlay.compatibility_failed_here: Codex checks failed on this computer
strings.overview.none_waiting: Nothing is waiting to be recovered
strings.panel.compat_acting_differs: The watcher is still acting on what it found when it started. Stop it and start it again on the Dashboard's Diagnostics page to check again.
strings.panel.compat_refresh: This data changes only when you ask: with Refresh compatibility data on the Dashboard's Diagnostics page, or with Check for updates.
strings.panel.compat_reported: What other people report about this Codex version is shown under Reported by others, beside the version on the Dashboard's Diagnostics page. It changes nothing here.
strings.panel.readonly: Read-only here. Use the Dashboard to change these.
strings.panel.start_ends_with_codex: Codex ends what its plugins start, so this watcher stops when Codex closes, if not sooner. Once Codex has closed, open Codex Auto Resume from the Start menu and start it there, or turn on Run at Windows sign-in in the Dashboard so it starts with Windows.
strings.panel.off_no_sign_in: Nothing starts it on its own: Run at Windows sign-in is off. From the Start menu, open Codex Auto Resume and start it there, or turn on Run at Windows sign-in in the Dashboard so it starts with Windows.
strings.panel.off_sign_in: Run at Windows sign-in is on, but it is not running now. To start it so it keeps running after Codex closes, open Codex Auto Resume from the Start menu and start it there.
strings.panel.start_exited: It started and stopped again; nothing is watching.
strings.panel.start_may_end_with_codex: Windows would not say whether Codex ends what its plugins start, so this watcher may stop when Codex closes. If it does, open Codex Auto Resume from the Start menu and start it there, or turn on Run at Windows sign-in in the Dashboard so it starts with Windows.
strings.panel.start_unconfirmed: Started, but not confirmed running yet. Ask for the status again.
strings.panel.unavailable: Settings are not available in this view.
strings.pending.unavailable: This cannot be read right now
strings.popup.stale: That task changed before the click reached it, so nothing was done.
strings.popup.zero_note: At zero the watcher checks again; every safety check still applies.
strings.preview.note: This is the text that will be sent. The watcher adds one line after it to recognize the exact turn it starts.
strings.preview.source.global: Using the message for every interruption
strings.preview.source.per_reason: Using the message for this kind of interruption
strings.preview.source.standard: No custom message is set, so the Standard message is used
strings.preview.title: Preview
strings.preview.unavailable: Preview is not available right now.
strings.retry.checking: Checking now. Every safety check still applies; nothing is sent unless they all pass.
strings.retry.later: The usage reset is later; the watcher checks then.
strings.retry.next_poll: The watcher looks at its next check. Every safety check still applies.
strings.settings.confirm_restore: Reset every setting to its recommended value?
strings.settings.language_changed: Language changed. Anything already open changes the next time it opens.
strings.settings.load_failed: Could not read the local settings
strings.settings.saved: Saved. The watcher uses these from its next check.
strings.settings.startup_unchecked: Saved, except Run at Windows sign-in: what Windows holds could not be read, so it was left as it is. Save again in a moment.
strings.start.exited: It started and stopped again. See the logs in the installation folder.
strings.start.unconfirmed: Started, but not confirmed running yet
strings.start.waiting: Waiting for it to report in
strings.status.recovery_idle: Nothing will be recovered until it is running
strings.status.unavailable_detail: Settings can still be changed and saved
strings.stay.after_sleep: Tasks waiting after a long sleep
strings.timeline.title: Timeline
strings.tray.title: Codex Auto Resume
strings.help.quiet_hours_days: A recovery that falls due during quiet hours waits until they end; nothing else about it changes. Hours that run past midnight belong to the day they start on. Time spent in them does not count toward giving up on a usage limit.
strings.field.observe_only: Observe only: check everything, send nothing
strings.field.new_conversation_policy: A conversation seen for the first time
strings.help.default_tier: For every conversation without a choice of its own, and for interruptions detected from then on; choose for one conversation from its task's row in Pending. After a chance to object shows a notification first and sends only once the time to object has passed. Ask me first and Only notify me send nothing until you let the task continue.
strings.help.observe_only: Every check still runs, and when a continuation would have been sent is shown in Pending, History and the timeline; nothing is sent. Turn it off to let recovery send again.
strings.help.new_conversation_policy: Only notify me gives a conversation this product has never seen that choice as its own, so nothing is sent for it until you let a task continue or change how it resumes from its task's row.
strings.help.project_policy: Let this project resume and Hold this project for me are on a task's row in Pending and in the popup. A task of any other project, or of one that cannot be read, waits for you and is never dropped. For interruptions detected from then on; holding a project from a row also holds what it has waiting.
strings.popup.held: Waiting for you to let it continue
strings.popup.observe_only: Observe only: every check runs, and nothing is sent.
strings.error.invalid_time: that is not a time to postpone a recovery to
strings.error.not_later: a recovery can only be postponed to a later time
strings.error.too_far: a recovery can be postponed by a week at most
strings.error.not_held: that recovery is not waiting for you
strings.error.project_unreadable: the project of that conversation cannot be read
strings.error.too_many_projects: at most 50 projects can be listed
strings.msg.toast_held: This task waits for you: let it continue from the Dashboard.
strings.msg.toast_notify_only: This conversation only notifies; nothing is resumed automatically.
strings.msg.toast_objection: Continuing at {time} unless you stop it.
strings.confirm.release: Let "{name}" continue? Nothing is sent now; every check still applies.
strings.confirm.tier: Change how "{name}" resumes to "{tier}"? It asks you less before a continuation is sent. Nothing is sent now.
strings.confirm.project_always: Let the project of "{name}" resume? Its tasks may then be sent without asking you, as Settings allow. Nothing is sent now.
strings.result.postponed: Postponed until {time}. Nothing is sent before then.
strings.result.released: It may continue now. Every safety check still applies.
strings.result.project_always: Tasks of this project may resume without asking you, as Settings allow.
strings.result.project_never: Tasks of this project wait for you from now on.
strings.explain.would_send: Every check but Observe only passed at {time}: it would have been sent then. Nothing was sent.
strings.receipt.seen: Seen starting a turn in its conversation
strings.receipt.uncertain: Delivery uncertain: watched for a day, never sent again
strings.receipt.queued: Handed to Codex; not seen in the conversation yet
strings.why.thread_disabled: Automatic recovery is off for this conversation.
strings.why.cancel_requested: You asked for it not to be resumed.
strings.why.observe_only: Observe only is on, so nothing is sent.
strings.why.held: Its conversation or its project asks you first: nothing is sent until you let it continue.
strings.why.not_due: Its next check has not come yet.
strings.why.waiting_reset: The usage limit has not reset yet.
strings.why.postponed: It was postponed, or its conversation gives you time to object first.
strings.why.quiet_hours: It is quiet hours; it waits until they end.
strings.why.engine_incompatible: This Codex version is not supported, so nothing is sent.
strings.why.engine_unknown: Whether this Codex version is supported is not known yet.
strings.why.projection_table_missing: Codex's history is not in the form this product can read.
strings.why.home_lock_unavailable: Another watcher is in charge of this Codex folder.
strings.why.possibly_sent: It may already have been sent, so it is never sent again.
strings.why.other_recovery_in_flight: Another continuation of this conversation is on its way first.
strings.why.projection_stale: Codex's history is still catching up with the conversation.
strings.why.category_disabled: This kind of interruption is switched off in Settings.
strings.why.chain_cap: This task has had every continuation it may have.
strings.why.recovery_budget: It has used all its attempts.
strings.why.no_progress_budget: The last continuations made no progress, so it stopped.
strings.why.daily_submission_cap: This conversation has had five continuations in a day; it waits for the oldest to age out.
strings.why.thread_submission_cooldown: A continuation went to this conversation less than 15 minutes ago.
strings.why.desktop_app_unavailable: The Codex app is not running.
strings.why.notLoaded: The conversation is not open in the Codex app.
strings.why.loaded_state_unknown: Whether the conversation is open cannot be told yet.
strings.why.held_by_other_session: Open in another Codex session (a terminal or VS Code); it continues once the Codex app holds it.
strings.why.version_newer_than_engine: A newer Codex than the one here last ran this conversation; it continues once Codex is updated.
strings.why.usage_unknown: Usage could not be read, so it waits rather than guess.
strings.why.user_input_queued: Something of yours is queued in this conversation and goes first.
strings.field.retry_wait_5: Custom timing: fifth wait and after
strings.field.retry_jitter: Add up to a fifth to each wait
strings.field.chain_time_ceiling: Stop a task that keeps failing after
strings.field.task_changed_guard: If the task changed while it waited
strings.help.retry_wait_5: Used only when Retry timing is Custom. The first wait comes before a task's first continuation, each later one after a continuation of the same task failed again, and the fifth before every attempt after that. A rate limit's first wait is at least a minute, and a wait Codex names is never cut short. Whatever you choose, one conversation gets a continuation at most every 15 minutes and 5 times a day.
strings.retry.preview: Waits before attempts 1 to 5, if each continuation fails at once: {waits}
strings.retry.preview_jitter: Each may be up to a fifth longer.
strings.help.chain_time_ceiling: Measured from a task's first temporary failure to its latest, so time spent waiting - postponed, in quiet hours, or for the app - never counts. Usage limits are not affected. Give attempts back gives the time back too.
strings.help.task_changed_guard: Just before a continuation is sent, the conversation's model and approval mode and the git branch or commit of its folder are compared with when it stopped. Hold it for me waits until you let it continue; Resume, and tell me sends it and says so on the notification. Only a digest is kept, and nothing is read while this is Off. For interruptions detected from then on.
strings.help.context_guard: Codex's own count, read when an interruption is detected, where Codex keeps one. Show them in Pending puts the count beside the task; a Hold choice also keeps a task whose conversation has used more waiting until you let it continue. Nothing is read while this is Off. For interruptions detected from then on.
strings.warn.high_limits: These limits are high: a task that keeps failing can be continued many times before it stops, and every continuation uses your Codex usage.
strings.msg.toast_workspace_changed: Its branch, model or approval mode changed since it stopped: it waits for you to let it continue.
strings.msg.toast_context_cost: Its conversation has used more tokens than Settings allow: it waits for you to let it continue.

strings.help.ask_after_sleep_minutes: After this PC slept for longer than this, a recovery that fell due while it slept waits for you: one notification says how long it slept, and Pending lets each task continue or not. Nothing is sent until you do. While this or Keep this PC awake is on, the watcher also looks again as soon as the PC wakes.
strings.help.wait_for_network: When a recovery is due, Windows is asked whether this PC is connected to the internet before Codex's usage is read. While Windows reports no connection it waits, and looks again every minute. Nothing is sent to find out. Behind some proxies Windows reports no internet when there is; leave this off there.
strings.help.keep_awake_hours: While a task waits, Windows is asked not to let this PC sleep on its own, for at most the hours chosen each time tasks start waiting; the display may still turn off. Closing the lid or choosing Sleep still sleeps the PC, and no Windows setting is changed. On mains power only lets it sleep on battery as usual.

strings.choice.stop: Warn me, then stop the watcher
strings.help.memory_guard_limit: After every check, the memory the watcher has committed is compared with this. Warn me says so once and goes on; Warn me, then stop the watcher also stops it before its next check - nothing waiting is lost - and it stays stopped until you start it again. Diagnostics shows the most it has used. Nothing is compared while this is Off.
strings.help.status_file: After every check the watcher writes status.json in its settings folder, for a tool of your own to read: whether it runs, whether recovery is on, how many tasks wait and when the next is looked at, and Codex's usage as last read. It holds no conversation, name or path. Nothing in this product reads it, and it is removed when this is off.
